text:
zoe: Quick propose: ship a very small Optimize Toolkit pilot for ACME in 6w. Concrete must-haves: batching advisor (recommend + simulated impact), lightweight KV/prefix cache for chats, and conservative quant recommendations with an eval safety gate + auto-revert. Need to pick acceptance gates and what we defer.

ryan: Agree. For batching: show top-2 suggestions, include an estimated tokens/$ delta from a 1h simulated replay, and require confirm->canary (5%). No auto-apply without explicit opt-in.

marta: Cache: MVP should expose hit-rate and p95 delta, and target >=25% reduced repeated-prefix compute on our chat bench. Keep TTL strategy simple (per-conversation + age).

zoe: Draft ACs:
```
- Batching advisor: produces actionable recommendations with simulated tokens/$ estimate; applying starts a 5% canary
- Prefix/KV cache: visible hit-rate metric and >=25% repeat-prefix compute reduction on bench
- Quant recs: int8 presets + preflight eval; auto-revert to fp16 if eval drops by abs 3% (or rel 10%) during canary
- Eval alert: webhook + one example failing prompt; default threshold abs 3%
```

ryan: Add rollout safety: recommendation -> preview -> confirm -> canary -> monitor; if eval failure occurs twice within 24h, auto-revert. Also log the exact failing examples.

marta: Defer per-route thresholds and per-GPU micro-tuning to post-MVP. MVP includes recommended presets for common hardware.

ops-bot: created ticket RED-3210: optimize-slimline-pilot, assigned @zoe; link: https://phabricator.internal/RED-3210

zoe: I'll write the one-pager + ACs today and schedule a 30m sync. Ryan, can you take the batching sim infra? Marta, can you own the cache bench and metrics?

ryan: Yep, I'll post a small replay tool and baseline numbers in the ticket.

marta: I will run the chat bench and share hit-rate targets tomorrow.

zoe: If anyone expects a blocker to the 6w target, flag here by EOD.
